name: govctl-org/govctl
summary: Repository-native governance workflow for Codex that links RFC requirements and ADR decisions to acceptance-criteria work items, enforcing lifecycle rules and executable verification guards before completion.
evidence: Provides a documented global Codex installation path that generates govctl-managed skills and agents under `.codex`, including governed discussion, implementation, migration, review, and commit workflows.
Separates normative RFC obligations, ADR trade-offs and rejected alternatives, and Work Item scope and acceptance criteria into durable repository artifacts with an explicit authority hierarchy.

Seals normative RFC versions before implementation and rejects Work Item completion until acceptance criteria are resolved and all effective verification guards pass or have explicit reasoned waivers.
